comment: Pinned model weights: public URL + SHA-256, verified at setup download time. No url/sha256 pinned yet — the in-browser bake-off (build order step 2) decides the checkpoint. Until then the extension reports model state 'not-configured'. Every entry must pass the three-way license check (weights, base model, training data) for MIT-compatible redistribution before landing here.

models.notes: Primary ONNX detector, ~22MB int8 budget. Candidates under evaluation in the bake-off.
